sections.title: Volume is a vanity metric
body: More commits, more tokens, more lines: all of these go up when work is going badly too, because fixing things is also activity.

sections.title: First-turn resolution and rework share
body: First-turn resolution is the share of sessions completed without a correction turn. Rework share is the share of effort that came from corrected sessions. Read them together: high resolution with rising rework means work is being deferred, not done.
points: Never read a speed metric alone
Drill into the modules where friction concentrates
Treat a rising rework trend as an early warning

sections.title: Grouped by what they answer
body: Sensei groups its metrics by outcome, quality, velocity, usage and cost, and always shows velocity next to its quality companion.

takeaway: Measure right work, not more work.
takeawaySub: Sensei pairs every speed metric with its quality companion.
